posts.title: Closing summary
posts.text: I’m going to wrap up coverage for now. Here’s a summary of what you need to know as Iran steps up strikes against US allies in the Gulf again. Iran launched a six-drone attack on a US airbase in Bahrain early on Sunday, prompting fears of a return to full-blown fighting after a two-month lull in strikes Bahrain said…

Iran’s Revolutionary Guards have claimed the sinking of an oil supertanker which hit a mine in the Strait of Hormuz. There’s no independent verification of this yet. As I mentioned earlier, Iran’s Revolutionary Guards have said its strikes this morning were retaliation for US aggression.
